strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout: 10% bulk discount at 10+ items (summed quantities), the SAVE5 coupon ($5 off after the bulk discount, floored at $0, other codes refused), and $4.99 shipping unless discounted goods reach $50 (empty cart costs $0). The logic lives in src/cart.js (bulkDiscount, cartTotal); unit tests with Vitest must prove each rule and its boundaries. Reading the code, bulkDiscount uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart with exactly 10 items looks like it gets no discount; the boundary test should expose this.
inScope: Bulk threshold boundaries (9/10/11 items across several lines)
SAVE5 ordering after bulk discount, $0 floor, refusal of other codes
Free shipping threshold on discounted goods, empty cart
outOfScope: UI / checkout page (none in the repo)
assumptions: Amounts are rounded to cents by the app; tests compare exact cent values with toBe.
A refused coupon is signalled by cartTotal throwing an Error whose message names the submitted code.
Coupon codes are case-sensitive: 'save5' is 'any other coupon code' and is refused.
The coupon is applied to an empty cart without error and the total stays $0.
openQuestions: Should coupon codes be case-insensitive (is 'save5' valid)? Tests assume they are case-sensitive, as the code is.

risks.description: Off-by-one at the 10-item bulk threshold (code uses > instead of >=)
risks.mitigation: TC1 tests exactly 10 items; TC2/TC3 bracket it

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount, or shipping threshold checked on pre-discount subtotal
risks.mitigation: TC4 and TC8/TC9 use amounts where the wrong order gives a different total

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart whose line quantities add up to 10 or more gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets no bulk discount.
SAVE5 takes $5 off the goods after the bulk discount, never taking the goods below $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied at exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1 says a cart with 10 or more items gets 10% off. bulkDiscount in src/cart.js uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items gets no discount. Expected total 26.59 for 10 items with $24 subtotal; actual is 28.99 (no discount).
defects.evidence: Code: `return itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD ? ...` with BULK_THRESHOLD = 10. The test is marked it.fails and passes only because its assertion fails.
